cross_source_lineage.drive_diff_observed: Drive app.py uses config.instanz.port('webd') while the frozen Project-Frankenstein head still hard-codes PORT=8093, proving at least one later Drive-side code delta.
cross_source_lineage.security_logic_shared: The frozen PF head contains the same scheme validator, private-host regex and fetch_url pattern relevant to the findings below.

security_findings.evidence: fetch_url validates only the initial textual hostname against a private-network regex and then uses urllib.request.urlopen, which follows redirects. No resolved-IP validation or redirect-target revalidation is present in this path.
security_findings.risk: A public-looking hostname or redirect chain can potentially reach loopback/private/link-local targets even though obvious initial localhost/private literals are blocked.
security_findings.required_fix_contract: Resolve host to IPs before connect, reject loopback/private/link-local/reserved ranges, pin/validate the connected address, disable automatic redirect following or revalidate every redirect hop, and apply the same policy after DNS resolution.

security_findings.evidence: parse_rss_feed checks only _is_safe_url (http/https scheme) and directly opens the supplied URL; unlike fetch_url it does not apply _BLOCKED_HOSTS at all.
security_findings.risk: The local web service exposes an RSS fetch path that can request private-network HTTP(S) targets if a caller can supply the URL.
security_findings.required_fix_contract: Use one shared outbound-request policy for fetch, RSS, search redirects and every future network tool; no endpoint may implement its own weaker URL validation.

positive_controls: service binds to loopback rather than all interfaces
fetch_url rejects non-http(s) schemes and obvious literal private/localhost forms
download sizes and request timeouts are bounded
result limits are bounded at the HTTP handler

needle: All network effects must pass one typed egress authority, not endpoint-specific URL checks.
Network results remain untrusted evidence and must not grant further effect authority.
harness: Add SSRF tests for direct private addresses, alternative IP encodings, DNS-to-private resolution, redirect-to-private, link-local/metadata ranges and RSS parity.
Test the actual HTTP client behavior, not only validator unit functions.
claycode: Represent outbound network access as an effect with resolved destination class and redirect policy; URL text alone is not sufficient authority.
unifieddb: Record network effect provenance: requested URL, resolved IP class, redirect chain, response origin and policy decision.
frank: Web content is sensory evidence from an untrusted channel; fetched text never becomes instruction authority merely because it entered context.
clay: Centralize network capability mediation so security properties survive module dissolution into one binary.
